definitions.explanation: The soft white fiber from cotton plants, or fabric made from it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧は{綿|めん}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{綿|めん}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧は⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧に⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧。
examples.english: Cotton products are gentle on the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧は{綿|めん}の⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧が⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧。
examples.english: Cotton clothes are cool in summer.

notes:
USAGE: {綿|めん} refers to cotton as a material, commonly used for clothing and textiles.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {綿|めん}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧% (100% cotton)
- {綿|めん}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (cotton products)
- {純綿|じゅんめん} (pure cotton)
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧ (cotton cloth - also read as もめん)

READING NOTE: When referring to raw cotton or cotton wadding, it can be read as わた. As a material for fabric, it's typically read as めん.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {綿|めん} - cotton (fabric material)
- ⟦{麻|あさ}→麻：27726_asa⟧ - linen, hemp
- ⟦{絹|きぬ}→絹：01383_kinu⟧ - silk
- ⟦{羊毛|ようもう}→羊毛：20649_youmou⟧/⟦ウール→ウール：27712_uuru⟧ - wool
